slots.title: Daily Publishing Batch
slots.detail: User approved the reviewed batch. Published 10 verified jobs in one batch: 7 fresher/early-career IT, 1 fresher non-IT, 1 government/PSU research walk-in, and 1 walk-in. Brandix was excluded due to the user's insecure-connection report; Needl.ai replaced it. The already-published Amazon candidate was deduplicated and replaced by Google. Availability verification, generation and validation succeeded; Vercel deployment succeeded. All 10 jobs were queued for Telegram.
slots.delivery: Verify all → one GitHub batch → one deployment → Telegram
